text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 小剧场.
Environment: Small intimate theatre with stage at one end, audience seating in rows, central aisle and backstage access.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 4 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram / spatial production design.
Asset: Vicky environment library, scene-005-04, 小剧场, 多角度图. Generate one finished independent image, landscape 1536x1024 or larger.
Input image 1 is the existing environment identity reference. Reference board has 2 columns and 3 rows. Use ONLY bottom-left for this location; ignore all other places.
Any additional reference is the same scene's concept floor/site plan and is the geometric source of truth. Keep its footprint, entrances, openings, adjacencies, landmark arrangement and orientation fixed.
Request: One dedicated four-view camera sheet, tidy 2 by 2 panels labeled VIEW 1 NORTH, VIEW 2 EAST, VIEW 3 SOUTH, VIEW 4 WEST. Four genuinely different eye-level views looking from SOUTH toward NORTH, WEST toward EAST, NORTH toward SOUTH, EAST toward WEST respectively around the SAME MAIN SPACE (for a multiroom suite, four views of main living area only; do not switch rooms). Match supplied layout plan exactly; repeated landmarks must occupy geometrically consistent locations. One must closely recover original reference view. Preserve original rendering medium, illumination, color palette and characteristic props. No mirrored duplicates, no different locations, no floorplan or diagrams.
Maintain the architecture, distinctive objects, material vocabulary and visual character of the original. Do not reuse the reference board as the output. Rationally extrapolate only unseen geometry; it is a coherent concept reconstruction for story staging, not surveyed construction documentation. Use one internally consistent space, not a collage of unrelated rooms. Walls meet logically, doors connect traversable spaces, no blocked entrances or impossible staircases. NO people, NO characters, NO animals, NO silhouettes, NO human figures in reflections or posters, NO logos/watermarks. Small legible English labels only where useful. Avoid busy ornament, repeated generic layouts and unexplained disconnected rooms.
Original design context (use only details compatible with target reference panel): 别演，吻我 · 排练厅正反打／走廊／化妆间／剧场／门厅

STRICT SPATIAL SCOPE: Draw ONLY the target location 小剧场. Treat every other reference-board panel as a different unrelated location. Do not import props, cages, benches, stairs, furniture or rooms from other panels. Extrapolate only the immediate target footprint. Do NOT assemble a whole multi-function complex. For a room, confine plan to that room, with adjoining rooms dashed and unshown. For outdoor space show only site boundary and immediately bounding facades, no invented building interiors.
LABEL OVERRIDE: Label the four camera panels A, B, C, D only (no compass directions). Show the entrance view, left oblique view, reverse view, right oblique view of ONE coherent location with fixed furniture. Avoid misleading cardinal direction captions.
OVERRIDE: The sole attached image is the finalized plan of this target scene. Ignore old multi-panel selection instructions. Follow its layout exactly. Preserve the source genre from context, clear fixed entrances, windows and landmark arrangements. No metric scale or compass labels. For multi-view show A,B,C,D camera labels only. No humans even in posters or statues.
